card.text: Sun-like star 1.34 parsecs away; its photosphere is not imaged here.

introduction.text: Alpha Centauri A is the larger star of the nearest stellar system, 1.34 parsecs away and 1.22 times the Sun's radius. Here its surface is a plain sphere.

shape.title: Sphere of the measured radius
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray. No picture of the surface is cast here.
